about: Videos that rebuild a known song's sequence, for lessons/sequencer-compare.qmd (students rebuild the line on the page and export it as JSON). Each video was checked to exist on 2026-11-25 through YouTube's oEmbed endpoint (title and channel below are what it returned). Whether each video's line matches the record is not checked. The analog-step list is not of the Moog 960 itself: no video of a 960 recreating a song was found, so these are other step sequencers playing the kind of line a 960 plays.
